## Personal Summary

Gulam Sarvar (also known as Sheikh Gulam Sarvar, SheikhSarvar, and Ghulam Sarwar) is an AI Engineer and
Agentic Systems Architect based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India, specialising in production-grade agentic AI,
durable workflow orchestration with Temporal.io, real-time voice AI telephony with 3CX,
and enterprise data systems with Oracle.

**Name variants used across platforms**:
- **Gulam Sarvar** — primary name, used on portfolio, LinkedIn, and professional communications
- **Sheikh Gulam Sarvar** — full legal name
- **SheikhSarvar** — GitHub handle (https://github.com/SheikhSarvar)
- **Ghulam Sarwar** — phonetic / alternate transliteration
- **sheikhgulamsarvar** — email prefix (sheikhgulamsarvar@gmail.com)

All the above names refer to the same individual.
He holds an MSc in Computer Science (AI & ML) from Woolf University (2023–2026) and currently works as
AI Engineer at EatEasy in Bengaluru, India (October 2026–Present), after having served as Associate Data Scientist
at Bluebash Pvt Ltd (April 2024–October 2026).

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/gulam-sarvar/
GitHub: https://github.com/SheikhSarvar

## Production Experience

### AI Engineer — EatEasy (October 2026–Present)

At EatEasy, Gulam Sarvar architects autonomous agentic platforms and enterprise voice telephony:
- Engineering a universal agentic workflow platform unifying n8n-style visual graph execution with autonomous multi-agent task execution.
- Implementing durable, fault-tolerant distributed state machines using Temporal.io for mission-critical workflows with zero state loss.
- Deploying bi-directional voice telephony (inbound customer service / IVR and high-throughput outbound conversational voice campaigns) using 3CX and WebRTC pipelines.
- Designing enterprise transactional schemas and high-throughput query services across Oracle and vector backends.

### Associate Data Scientist / AI Engineer — Bluebash Pvt Ltd (April 2024–October 2026)

- Built Kickcall (Bluebash's voice AI product) from scratch: a real-time STT→LLM→TTS pipeline running 150–200 calls/day at <2s end-to-end latency using WebRTC/LiveKit and Redis session state.
- Led technical direction for a ~5-person cross-functional team building RAG systems for legal and healthcare clients.
- Designed hybrid retrieval architecture using Qdrant/Pinecone with reranking; improved retrieval accuracy significantly over naive baselines.
- Containerized all services with Docker for EC2 deployment.

## Flagship & Key Projects

### OmniFlow Agentic Platform (Autonomous Workflow & Telephony Engine)
- Universal agentic workflow orchestrator built to execute arbitrary business logic.
- Visual & programmatic graph automation (similar to n8n) coupled with dynamic multi-agent tools.
- Dual-way voice AI: Inbound interactive voice response (IVR) and automated outbound calling via 3CX and WebRTC (<1.5s latency).
- Fault-tolerant distributed execution guarantees powered by Temporal.io.
- Enterprise data layer with Oracle and vector databases.
- Stack: Temporal.io, 3CX, Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, Oracle, LiveKit, WebRTC, Docker, Redis, TypeScript.

### Kickcall — Voice AI Product (Bluebash)
- Built from scratch by Gulam Sarvar.
- STT→LLM→TTS pipeline handling 150–200 calls/day in live production with latency < 2 seconds.
- Stack: LiveKit, WebRTC, LangGraph, OpenAI, Redis, FastAPI, Python, Docker.

### PyRAG Core (Open Source)
- Repo: https://github.com/SheikhSarvar/pyrag-core
- MIT-licensed Python/FastAPI/LangGraph RAG platform with 143 unit tests.
- Pluggable vector backend architecture with production-tested Qdrant support.

## Technical Skills Detail

### Workflow & Distributed Systems
- Temporal.io: durable workflows, activities, state recovery, cron execution, distributed saga patterns
- n8n & Event-Driven DAGs: multi-step trigger/action automation, webhook routing, arbitrary execution graphs
- Distributed state management, worker queues, and event streams

### Voice AI & Telephony
- 3CX Telephony: PBX integration, SIP trunking, call routing, automated inbound handling & outbound campaign dispatch
- LiveKit & WebRTC: real-time streaming audio, LiveKit Agents SDK
- STT/TTS Pipelines: streaming speech-to-text, low-latency voice synthesis, conversational turn-taking

### Databases & Enterprise Storage
- Oracle: enterprise relational database design, high-concurrency transactional queries
- Vector Databases: Qdrant, Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate
- Caching & State: Redis session state, distributed locking

### AI & Agents
- LangGraph: multi-agent stateful graph architectures, human-in-the-loop, tool synthesis
- LangChain, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, Gemini, Ollama, LM Studio
- Observability: Langfuse, LangSmith
